items.headline: DeepSeek releases DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash
items.summary: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash is a 552B-parameter MoE model with a new causal encoder-decoder design (8B active parameters for input, 16B for output) and native image understanding; DeepSeek says it outperforms V4-Pro and cuts KV-cache memory substantially. Weights and a technical report are on Hugging Face.
